sourceChecks.text: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

profileDecisionJa: ヒゼキヤの母として名が記されています。本文は彼女をゼカリヤの娘と呼びます。

wikipediaReadEvidence.title: Abijah (queen)
wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: L10–16: identifies Abijah as wife of Ahaz and mother of Hezekiah.
wikipediaReadEvidence.supportJa: 記事はヒゼキヤの母としてのアビヤを、ユダの王アハズの妻と説明しています。
